name: poly_davenport_sharp_deg_two
statement: : IsLeast {d : ℕ | ∃ f g : Polynomial ℚ, f.natDegree = 2 ∧ g.natDegree = 3 ∧ f ^ 3 ≠ g ^ 2 ∧ (f ^ 3 - g ^ 2).natDegree = d} 2
closed: IsLeast {d : ℕ | ∃ f g : Polynomial ℚ, f.natDegree = 2 ∧ g.natDegree = 3 ∧ f ^ 3 ≠ g ^ 2 ∧ (f ^ 3 - g ^ 2).natDegree = d} 2
informal: Davenport's bound is sharp in degree (2,3): the least possible degree of f^3 - g^2 ≠ 0 with deg f = 2, deg g = 3 over ℚ is exactly 2 — membership by f = X^2 + 2, g = X^3 + 3X (f^3 - g^2 = 3X^2 + 8); lower bound Uses Mathlib2.ms_davenport: f.natDegree + 2 = 4 ≤ 2·d.
type: IsLeast {d | ∃ f g, f.natDegree = 2 ∧ g.natDegree = 3 ∧ f ^ 3 ≠ g ^ 2 ∧ (f ^ 3 - g ^ 2).natDegree = d} 2
